entry.title: H6 · Trust-matched quantum vs classical systems benchmark
entry.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis

fields.label: Statement
fields.text: Compare on matched topology/trust. P05 already measured a time advantage for one setting, so QMint can only add *breadth* (more topologies, explicit classical H0–H6 baselines, RIPE-measured RTTs) and must cite P05 as the origin of the measured advantage.
